note: Beaumont-Cherry Valley Recreation & Park District park in an oak canyon in the foothills ~5 mi north of Beaumont, with a fishing pond, hiking, biking and horse trails, and group and equestrian camps beside the family sites. An attendant is on site at weekends. The district does not say which sites take RVs or how long. --Claude
